world.topic:
Second round on the paper-writing worker of the positions paper-repo and internal-review-repo of the research world rw_313df9cf84a4 (PaperWrite-Bench paper_29, given to you to read), starting from what the first round delivered: the diagnosis, the rubric and the held-out protocol, and the candidates cand-a and cand-b (a CLAUDE.md asset with writing and review norms; cand-b also at higher effort), whose paper_29 runs scored 0.79-0.82, within the incumbent's range. The incumbent is still a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers:incumbent@v3 (Claude Code, claude-sonnet-5-5, effort low). The goal is a worker that really writes better papers; keeping the incumbent is a result only if no candidate wins before this world's wall clock ends.

The held-out world changed: rw_557d19f77f34 could not be continued from c0 (a world problem, recorded and fixed apart from this world). Its replacement is rw_19be25bd2f7d, the same paper_39 (ACL 2025) task, given to you to read, checkpoint c0, never run; continuing it from c0 was checked. The held-out paper's writing material, exactly what the benchmark gives its writers, is now the resource heldout-material (paper_39/), so the judge can check every manuscript's numbers and claims against the source. rw_19be25bd2f7d, the heldout-material resource, the verifier files of paper_39 and every world made from rw_19be25bd2f7d belong to the task-setter and the judge alone: the judge runs the held-out worlds itself, and the sparring-partner, the tuner and the diagnostician do not read any of them.

Comparison and decision: run the incumbent and each candidate at least five times each on the held-out paper, all from c0 of rw_19be25bd2f7d and all at the same time, judged as the protocol says (verifier reward with every component, and the blind rubric). Keep a candidate only if both hold on the held-out paper: its blind writing-quality score is above the incumbent's by more than the spread of the runs, and its verifier reward is not below the incumbent's. If no candidate passes, make a new round of at most two candidates from what the judging shows, and compare again, until one passes or this world's wall clock runs out; at least one candidate in every round changes writing content through assets, and one that changes only effort says so.

Put back and publish, as before: put the kept worker back by continuing rw_313df9cf84a4 from its newest checkpoint with it and running that round; the judge approves the release only after it. Publish the kept worker to a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers by a pull request through the github resource: its worker.json written by `worker show` and passing `worker check`, beside a README.md that says what it changed against incumbent@v3 and by how much on which measures (writing quality and each verifier component, with the spread); if the incumbent is kept, the README says why and on which measures the difference stayed within the spread.

Every world you run: the full configuration of the world it continues with only the worker of paper-repo and internal-review-repo changed, and "resources": [] written out (a world made here without it gets this world's resources, the held-out material among them); budget.total_seconds 1800, at most 12 turns and 1800 model seconds. This world ends at its wall-clock budget; have the release and the pull request done well before it.
